title: Roamhaven Rewards Member Service Benefits Chart
content:
Three service benefits of Roamhaven Rewards depend on the member's tier: access to the priority guest support line, a named concierge, and the choice of one annual benefit.

| Tier | Priority guest support line | Named concierge | Chooses one annual benefit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | No | No | No |
| Rewards Silver | No | No | No |
| Rewards Gold | Yes | No | No |
| Rewards Platinum | Yes | No | No |
| Rewards Diamond | Yes | Yes | No |
| Rewards Ambassador | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the chart

- **Priority guest support line:** reached by members in Rewards Gold, Rewards Platinum, Rewards Diamond and Rewards Ambassador. Members in Rewards Member and Rewards Silver do not reach it.
- **Named concierge:** held by members in Rewards Diamond and Rewards Ambassador only.
- **Annual choice benefit:** a member in Rewards Ambassador chooses one annual benefit; no other tier has this benefit.

Each benefit follows the member's current tier. A member holding Rewards Diamond has the priority line and a named concierge but does not choose an annual benefit; a member holding Rewards Gold reaches the priority line and has neither of the other two.
